# Tests

## Basic

### Grid Bota

```{r}
grid_config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10,
  Metric = "Count")

grid <- grid_read(grid_config)

plot_grid(grid)
```

### Grid Genet (test name not in genet)

```{r}
grid_config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "GH",
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Aaaaa", # Unkown Name
  Metric = "Reads")

grid <- grid_read(grid_config)

plot_grid(grid)
```

### Grid Bota (all Metric)

```{r}
# Config
basic_config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10)

# No filters
grid_filters <- list()

# All metric
all_metrics <- c("Count","NCI","OTU","Shannon","H1")

# All plots
all_plots <- list()

for (m in all_metrics) {
  grid_config <- basic_config
  grid_config$Metric <- m
  
  # Grid Read
  grid <- grid_read(
    config = grid_config,
    filters = grid_filters
  )
  
  # Plot
  all_plots[[m]] <- plot_grid(grid)
  
}

Wrap <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 5) + 
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Toutes les Metrics pour l'inventaire :  ", basic_config$Type, " / ", basic_config$Level, " / ", basic_config$Name, " / R = ", basic_config$Radius))


```

### Grid Genet (all Metric)

```{r}


# Config
basic_config <- list(
  Type = "genet",
  Rar = FALSE,
  Marker = "GH",
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae")

# Filters
grid_filters <- list()
# grid_filters <- list(
#   filter_plant = FALSE,
#   filter_monocot = FALSE,
#   filter_na_family = FALSE,
#   filter_na_sp = FALSE,
#   filter_valid_sp = FALSE
# )


# All metric
all_metrics <- c("Reads","OTU","Shannon","H1")

# All plots
all_plots <- list()

for (m in all_metrics) {
  grid_config <- basic_config
  grid_config$Metric <- m
  
  # Grid Read
  grid <- grid_read(
    config = grid_config,
    filters = grid_filters
  )
  
  # Plot
  all_plots[[m]] <- plot_grid(grid)
  
}

Wrap <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 4) + 
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Toutes les Metrics pour l'inventaire :  ", basic_config$Type, " / ", basic_config$Level, " / ", basic_config$Name)

```
